entry.title: dotnet/sdk - Issues & Pull Requests - 2026-03-03
entry.content:
Issues

Created

  • Create end to end test(s) that invokes AOT'd application instead of managed application #53243
  • Set up pipeline to create AOT'd CLI application and get in SDK layout #53242
  • .NET 11 Preview workload manifests use wrong feature band in .NET SDK archives #53234
  • PackAsTool package contains pdb even though symbol package gets produced #53226
  • [NETSDKE2E][Regression] The implicit runtime is different with VS carries in the VS18.5 Insider 1 + net11-preview.2 #53224
  • [NETSDKE2E][Regression]For 10.0.201/10.0.105(10.0.5 ) hot fix, it needs to depend on 9.0.14 and 8.0.25 #53222

Closed

  • Can't create/build Blazor (Wasm) without problems of missing Workloads? #30067
  • Not able to access File server from inside container running Asp.Net 4.7.2 window service #30045
  • Rationalize short and long RIDs #30041
  • `dotnet --version` breaks mouse scrolling in Linux terminal #53209
